channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio defende maioridade aos 14 para casos de estupro em aceno às mulheres
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro advocated lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 14 years for crimes such as rape during a speech at a PL party event in Santa Catarina, targeting female voters. The proposal was framed as part of his agenda to combat violence against women.

item.title: Governistas elogiam Moraes por suspender aplicação da dosimetria
item.description: Allies of President Lula praised Minister Alexandre de Moraes' decision to suspend the application of the Dosimetry Law, arguing that the measure protects democracy by preventing Congress from reducing sentences for those involved in the anti-democratic acts of January 8. The suspension was celebrated as a constitutional victory against legislative maneuvers seeking to benefit coup plotters.

item.title: Instagram se consolida como ‘habitat’ da IA, e políticos disputam engajamento com perfis ‘sombrios’
item.description: Instagram has become the primary environment for AI-generated content, with 81.5% of 3,314 analyzed posts by Instituto Democracia em Xeque occurring on the platform. Opaque profiles like 'Dona Maria', which uses an AI-generated realistic image of an elderly Black woman to attack the PT, Lula, and the STF, have achieved engagement levels comparable to real politicians, prompting the Brazil of Hope Federation to request its suspension before the TSE. Meanwhile, pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) led in engagement with 137,000 interactions in a video comparing current taxation to the colonial regime, reinforcing his image as the 'anti-STF candidate'.

item.title: Após meses de disputa interna, PL oficializa chapa com Carlos Bolsonaro e Carol de Toni em Santa Catarina
item.description: The PL officially launched in Santa Catarina the reelection ticket for Governor Jorginho Mello, featuring Carlos Bolsonaro and Caroline de Toni as Senate candidates, following months of internal conflict. The event, attended by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, included criticism of the Supreme Court and the Lula government, along with advocacy for reducing the age of criminal responsibility and cutting public spending. The ticket excluded Senator Esperidião Amin (PP-SC), who was initially expected, after Caroline de Toni threatened to leave the party over her potential exclusion.

item.title: Suspensão de produtos da Ypê pela Anvisa mobiliza bolsonaristas contra a decisão
item.description: Anvisa suspended Ypê brand products after detecting Pseudomonas aeruginosa and identifying failures in Good Manufacturing Practices, posing health risks to vulnerable populations. The measure triggered a backlash from Bolsonaro supporters on social media, who accuse the Lula government of political retaliation due to the brand owners' financial support for Bolsonaro's 2022 campaign. Influencers and celebrities have shared videos using the products without checking batch numbers, fueling a controversy that blends public health and partisanship.

item.title: Moraes acerta ao suspender a Lei da Dosimetria, que parece ter nome e sobrenome
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes suspended the Dosimetry Law, passed by Congress after overriding the presidential veto, arguing it weakens penalties for crimes against democracy and violates the principle of insufficient protection. The law, which reduced sentences for attacks on democratic institutions, was deemed unconstitutional due to apparent targeting of specific defendants and social regression. Its suspension restores inter-branch balance and safeguards the integrity of Brazil’s penal system.

item.title: Energisa anuncia aporte de R$ 18 bilhões em 4 Estados
item.description: Energisa announced R$ 18 billion in investments between 2026 and 2030 across Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraíba, and Sergipe following the renewal of its 30-year electricity concession contracts. The funds will expand and modernize electrical infrastructure serving 5.7 million customers, with R$ 9.3 billion allocated to Mato Grosso. The signing ceremony, attended by President Lula and Minister Alexandre Silveira, marked a new regulatory framework emphasizing stricter service quality, climate resilience, and technological innovation.

item.title: As razões que o PT alegou para que o STF suspenda a lei da dosimetria
item.description: The PT, PCdoB, and PV asked the STF to suspend the Dosimetry Law, arguing that Congress cannot alter or split a presidential veto, as Davi Alcolumbre did by dividing Lula’s full veto. They called the vote atypical and unconstitutional, violating the separation of powers. PT leader Edinho Silva labeled the law a democratic setback, linking it to the alleged plot to assassinate Lula, Alckmin, and former TSE president Moraes.

item.title: Flávio critica Moraes por suspensão da Lei da Dosimetria: "Canetada"
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes for suspending the Dosimetry Law, calling it a 'bureaucratic stroke' and suggesting a 'combined scheme' with the bill's rapporteur in the Chamber, Deputy Paulinho da Força. He argued the decision undermined congressional sovereignty and stated the opposition will not grow accustomed to such judicial interventions, even as Brazil appears to be adapting to them.

item.title: Em evento de Flávio Bolsonaro, pré-candidatos do PL criticam Supremo
item.description: At a pre-candidacy event for Flávio Bolsonaro in Florianópolis, Senate candidates Carlos Bolsonaro and Carol de Toni criticized the Supreme Federal Court (STF), accusing it of abuse, censorship, and political injustice, particularly regarding Jair Bolsonaro's imprisonment. Flávio Bolsonaro also denounced a decision by Minister Alexandre de Moraes on the Dosimetry Law as a 'bureaucratic stroke'.

item.title: Moraes suspende aplicaçăo da Lei da Dosimetria, que reduz pena de Bolsonaro por golpe
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes suspended the application of the Sentencing Law, which could have drastically reduced Jair Bolsonaro's potential sentence for attempting a coup after the 2022 election. The ruling prevents the law from benefiting Bolsonaro, preserving the possibility of a 27-year-and-three-month prison term.

item.title: Brasil ampliará parcerias com EUA sem abrir măo da soberania, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil will expand partnerships with the United States without compromising sovereignty, describing the meeting with Donald Trump as productive and optimistic. He highlighted cooperation on bilateral trade, tariffs, combating organized crime, and critical minerals, and invited the U.S. to join the anti-crime base in Manaus, part of the upcoming Brazil Against Organized Crime plan.

item.title: Houve canetada monocrática na suspensăo do efeito da Lei da Dosimetria, diz Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for president, labeled the Supreme Court's suspension of the Dosimetry Law as a 'monocratic stroke of the pen,' claiming it was enacted without proper legislative debate.

item.title: 'É a democracia que fica abalada', diz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre decisão de Moraes
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that the decision by Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF to suspend the Dosimetry Law approved by Congress shakes democracy. He described the measure as an attack on the independence of powers and the popular will expressed in the law.

item.title: Após Moraes suspender aplicação da lei da dosimetria, oposição fala em possível reação no Congresso, enquanto governistas comemoram
item.description: Justice Alexandre de Moraes suspended the immediate application of the Dosimetry Law pending STF review of its constitutionality, responding to requests from the Brazilian Press Association (ABI) and the Psol/Rede federation. The decision drew divided reactions: opposition figures suggest a possible congressional response, while government allies view it as an indication the law may be ruled unconstitutional. Although monocratic, the ruling does not set a timeline for merit review, prompting caution even among the law’s critics.

item.title: Caso de condenada a 17 anos trava Lei da Dosimetria no STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes suspended the application of the Dosimetry Law (Law 15.402/2026) in the penalty execution process of Nara Faustino de Menezes, sentenced to 16 years and 6 months for her role in the January 8 acts, citing that the law is under review in two ADIs and that suspension is necessary to ensure legal certainty until the Court rules on its constitutionality. The ruling orders that her sentence be carried out according to the original, final judgment.

item.title: PT recorre ao STF contra Lei da Dosimetria, que beneficia Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT-PCdoB-PV federation filed an action at the STF against the Dosimetry Law, which reduces sentences and flexibilizes regime progression, arguing it is unconstitutional and risks encouraging new democratic attacks. Minister Alexandre de Moraes suspended the law's application pending final judgment by the Court, granting a precautionary measure. The law benefits former President Jair Bolsonaro and others involved in the January 8, 2023, acts.

item.title: Flávio critica “canetada monocrática” de Moraes sobre Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes' decision to suspend the application of the Dosimetry Law, calling it a 'monocratic pen stroke' that overturned a decision approved by the National Congress.

item.title: Moraes deu “canetada” ao suspender Lei da Dosimetria, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Minister Alexandre de Moraes of issuing a "pen stroke" by suspending the Dosimetry Law, which he views as a monocratic decision overriding Congress's will. The statement was made in Florianópolis during the PL's launch of Senate and gubernatorial candidates in Santa Catarina, where he endorsed his brother Carlos Bolsonaro, Carol De Toni, and Governor Jorginho Mello for re-election.

item.title: Moraes suspende aplicação da Dosimetria até STF julgar recursos contra a lei
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes suspended the application of the Dosimetry Law (15.402/2026), which reduces sentences for those convicted in the January 8, 2023 attacks, pending the Court's review of two direct actions of unconstitutionality (ADIs). The law, enacted after Congress overrode President Lula's veto, would notably benefit former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a 27-year sentence.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro critica decisão de Moraes de suspender Lei da Dosimetria antes de julgamento: 'Canetada burocrática'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the Supreme Federal Court for suspending the application of the Dosimetry Law, calling it a 'bureaucratic stroke' and accusing him of colluding with the bill’s rapporteur, Deputy Paulinho da Força. He claimed the decision undermines Congress and the people’s will, reinforcing his opposition to judicial overreach.

item.title: Pix é do Bolsonaro e Master é do Lula, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) claimed that Pix is associated with Bolsonarism and Mastercard with Lula, during an event in Florianópolis where he launched the Senate candidacies of his brother Carlos Bolsonaro and deputy Carol De Toni, and declared support for Governor Jorginho Mello’s re-election. He also accused the Workers’ Party (PT) of opposing the initiation of a parliamentary inquiry into Banco Master, calling the party’s current stance 'theater'.

item.title: Moraes suspende lei de dosimetria para condenados pelo 8 de janeiro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has suspended the application of the sentencing law for those convicted of the January 8 attacks until the full court rules on the Direct Actions of Unconstitutionality challenging the norm. The decision follows requests for information from President Lula and Congress, and was prompted by ADIs filed by the Brazilian Press Association and the PSOL-Rede federation, which Moraes deemed a new and relevant procedural fact requiring legal caution.

item.title: Renan Santos critica quem diz ser autista para ter benefícios
item.description: Renan Santos, a presidential pre-candidate and MBL member, criticized individuals who allegedly fake autism to obtain social benefits like BPC and car discounts, claiming fraud involving false psychiatric and legal reports. He also opposed the Berenice Piana Law, inclusive education for autistic students, and the public disclosure of actress Letícia Sabatella’s diagnosis, calling her 'narcissistic' and the diagnosis 'glamorized'. Santos pledged to audit BPC benefits rigorously if elected.

item.title: PT escolhe Jilmar Tatto para coordenar grupo de trabalho focado nas eleições
item.description: The PT has established a working group led by federal deputy Jilmar Tatto to assemble competitive slates and strengthen Lula’s re-election bid in 2026. The group replaces José Guimarães, now head of the SRI ministry, and will coordinate state-level alliances, mediate local disputes, and build a progressive front to counter Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy, which Tatto labels a 'coupist' and 'sellout' project. Tatto emphasized the race will be highly competitive, with Lula and Bolsonaro technically tied in polls, and dismissed the viability of a third way.

item.title: Moraes suspende aplicação da Lei da Dosimetria até STF analisar medida que beneficia Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes suspended the application of the Dosimetry Law until the Court reviews two Direct Actions of Unconstitutionality challenging its validity. The law, enacted after Congress overrode Lula’s veto, reduces sentences for those involved in the January 8 attacks and benefits Bolsonaro, who was sentenced to 27 years for attempting a coup. The suspension followed a request from a January 8 convict seeking the law’s benefit, which Moraes said depends on the STF’s ruling on the ADIs.

item.title: Flávio lança jingle para pré-campanha: "Entrar com o pé direito"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) launched a jingle for his 2026 presidential pre-campaign, featuring the slogans 'Step in with the right foot' and 'Brazil has a future'. The song counters Bolsonarist criticism of Havaianas' campaign and contrasts with Lula's focus on past legacy, emphasizing future change. The campaign plans complementary actions, such as WhatsApp stickers, based on these themes.

item.title: Moraes suspende aplicação da lei da dosimetria até julgamento do STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes suspended the application of the dosimetry law that reduces sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, pending the Court's ruling on its validity. The decision responds to defense requests from convicted individuals, including a lawyer sentenced to 16 years, citing legal security amid challenges to the law. The law was promulgated this Friday after Congress overturned the presidential veto, but remains subject to judicial review.

item.title: Moraes suspende aplicação da Lei da Dosimetria até que STF se manifeste sobre ações
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes, rapporteur at the STF, suspended the application of the Dosimetry Law until the Supreme Court rules on two actions challenging its constitutionality, citing legal insecurity risks. The law, passed by Congress after overturning Lula’s veto, reduces penalties for crimes committed in crowds and is challenged by Psol, Rede, and ABI for benefiting those involved in the January 8th coup attempt.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lança palanque do PL em Santa Catarina
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro officially launched the PL's 'pure-blood' Senate ticket in Santa Catarina, endorsing his brother Carlos Bolsonaro and deputy Carol De Toni following a split with Senator Espiridião Amin. The event also affirmed his support for Governor Jorginho Mello's re-election bid. Although trailing Lula nationally, Flávio leads the president in Santa Catarina polls, per a Futura/Apex survey.

item.title: Flávio exclui Amin e escolhe Carlos para vaga no Senado por SC
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro launched his brother Carlos Bolsonaro as the Senate candidate for Santa Catarina, sidelining Senator Espiridião Amin after an internal party split. He also endorsed Deputy Carol De Toni for another Senate seat and Governor Jorginho Mello for re-election. A Futura/Apex poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro defeating Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Santa Catarina in a potential runoff.

item.title: Lula não deveria ter jogado gasolina na fogueira do caso Enel, diz especialista
item.description: President Lula used Enel as a scapegoat in his speech, according to Adriano Pires of CBIE, which further politicized the energy crisis. The expert criticized the approach as inflammatory and inappropriate for addressing the structural issue.

item.title: Moraes suspende aplicação da Lei da Dosimetria até que o STF analise ações que questionam a norma
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes suspended the application of the Dosimetry Law until the STF rules on the constitutionality challenges. The measure affects those convicted of the January 8 attacks, including former President Jair Bolsonaro, who awaits a decision on sentence reduction. So far, Moraes has applied this suspension in at least ten penal executions.

item.title: Hélio Lopes aciona CBF para pedir convocação de Neymar para a Copa do Mundo
item.description: Federal Deputy Hélio Lopes (PL), an ally of Jair Bolsonaro, sent an official letter to the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) requesting Neymar's call-up for the 2026 World Cup, citing his record as Brazil's all-time top scorer and his role as a unifying national symbol. Despite not being selected since 2023 and limited playing time at Santos in 2026 (12 appearances, 5 goals), Lopes argued the request reflects the wishes of millions of Brazilians, emphasizing it does not seek technical interference with the coaching staff's decisions.

item.title: Reunião com Trump reduz desgaste de Lula nas redes, diz Bites
item.description: Lula's meeting with Trump and the PF operation targeting Ciro Nogueira reduced negative social media mentions, but his image remains unfavorable. Negative mentions dropped from 54.6% to 43.6% between April 29 and May 7, as allies seek to counter narratives of congressional weakness. The term 'BolsoMaster' was used by supporters to link investigations to Flávio Bolsonaro's network.

item.title: Investigação das fraudes no INSS tem uma boa e uma má notícia para Lula
item.description: So far, INSS whistleblower testimonies do not personally implicate President Lula in the fraud scheme that stole over R$ 6 billion from retirees, but they do implicate his longtime allies and his son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha). The plea deal with businessman Maurício Camisotti, described as the scheme’s business arm, was initially agreed upon by the PF but paused to involve the PGR, indicating institutional coordination. The restart of Camisotti’s testimony is seen as a positive sign of investigative unity, even though it does not reach the president directly.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio vai a lançamento de pré-candidaturas do PL em SC
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attends the launch of the pre-candidacies of Carlos Bolsonaro (PL-SC) and Carol De Toni (PL-SC) for the Federal Senate in Florianópolis at the Music Park complex in Jurerê. The event also formalizes Jorginho Mello (PL) as the pre-candidate for re-election as governor of Santa Catarina, with live streaming on the PL Santa Catarina profile. The schedule includes meetings with business leaders and institutional visits, featuring participation from state and national party leaders such as Senator Jorge Seif (PL-SC).

item.title: Vice de Nunes recomenda uso de Ypê, mesmo após alerta de Vigilância de SP e proibição da Anvisa
item.description: São Paulo's vice mayor, Ricardo Mello Araújo (PL), publicly defended the use of Ypê products despite health warnings from Anvisa and São Paulo's State Health Surveillance due to microbial contamination in certain batches. He accused authorities of unfairly targeting the company, aligning with narratives of political persecution against Bolsonaro supporters. Ypê had donated to the PL campaign in 2022, and Araújo was recently passed over by the party for a Senate spot in São Paulo.

item.title: O jantar de cinco horas para Flávio Bolsonaro em Miami
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended a five-hour dinner in Miami hosted by Marcelo Kayath, attended by around 20 Brazilians, mostly from the financial sector and former corporate executives, including Eduardo Bartolomeo, former CEO of Vale. The gathering highlighted ties between Bolsonaro’s circle and Brazilian economic elites residing abroad, particularly in Miami. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Centrão barrou Messias para impedir investigações sobre Vorcaro, diz PT
item.description: PT congressional leader Pedro Uczai claims the rejection of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court was part of a congressional 'big deal' to block investigations into businessman Daniel Vorcaro and reduce sentences for those involved in the January 8 attacks. He alleges the maneuver involved Ciro Nogueira, Davi Alcolumbre, and Flávio Bolsonaro to weaken the January 8 CPMI and prevent an investigative ally from joining the STF.

item.title: Lula vê em Trump seu maior aliado contra ações hostis da Casa Branca
item.description: Lula’s team brought paper documents to a meeting with Trump in Washington to avoid hostile actions from the White House. The Brazilian president views Trump as a strategic ally against U.S. pressures. The move reflects concerns over bilateral relations amid potential protectionist or interventionist measures from the United States.

item.title: Alvo da PF, Ciro Nogueira passa a ser renegado pelo bolsonarismo
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI), targeted in a Federal Police operation for allegedly using his mandate to serve the interests of banker Daniel Vorcaro (owner of Master), has been renounced by Bolsonaro allies, who now describe him as merely a 'circumstantial ally' and recall his past closeness to Lula. Despite being considered as a potential running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro and having served as Chief of Staff in Bolsonaro's government, his reputation has been damaged by corruption allegations.

item.title: Lacunas na proposta de delação de Vorcaro
item.description: Investigators consider Daniel Vorcaro’s plea bargain proposal selective and insufficient, as he appears to be protecting allies by naming only certain targets, such as Senator Ciro Nogueira. STF ministers state the plea deal will only be valid if full restitution of involved funds is made, rejecting partial negotiations. Meanwhile, the STF advances measures against judiciary benefits ('penduricalhos'), and the TSE faces the challenge of countering 'synthetic fakes' on social media with electoral intent.

item.title: Estratégia do PL no Rio será colocar Eduardo Paes ‘no colo de Lula’
item.description: The PL's strategy in Rio de Janeiro is to link Eduardo Paes' (PSD) image with President Lula to exploit the latter's unpopularity in the state, where Bolsonaro won in both 2018 and 2022. Although Paes leads in polls with 34%, the PL seeks to undermine his proximity to Lula, while Paes aims to broaden his support by selecting evangelical Jane Reis (MDB) as his running mate, sister of a Bolsonaro ally.

item.title: Defesa de Débora do Batom pede revisão da pena ao STF
item.description: The defense of Débora Rodrigues dos Santos, known as 'Débora do batom', filed a petition with the STF to review her 14-year prison sentence for the January 8 attacks, citing the new Dosimetry Law. The defense argues the law reduces penalties for participants in a 'crowd context' without leadership and requests the maximum 2/3 sentence reduction, seeking immediate release.

item.title: Novo lança André Marinho ao governo do Rio em evento com Zema
item.description: The Novo party launched the pre-candidacy of comedian and communicator André Marinho for the Rio de Janeiro state government at an event held on Saturday, the 9th. The launch featured the presence of former Minas Gerais governor and presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema, also from Novo. Marinho, son of businessman Paulo Marinho, is set to face former mayor Eduardo Paes and other contenders in the state race.

item.title: Com a presença de Zema, Novo lança aliado de família Bolsonaro ao governo do Rio
item.description: The Novo party launched the pré-candidacy of André Marinho, a 31-year-old communicator and son of Bolsonaro ally Paulo Marinho, for governor of Rio de Janeiro. The event featured Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pré-candidate for president, who emphasized opposition to the state's political system. Marinho frames Eduardo Paes and Douglas Ruas as direct adversaries, aiming to unite evangelicals, military, anti-PT, and Lava Jato supporters in a campaign of outrage against the left and 'Alerj's bloodsuckers'.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest mostra disputa Lula x Flávio a menos de cinco meses da eleição
item.description: Genial/Quaest released a new presidential poll for 2026 with 2,004 face-to-face interviews, a 2-percentage-point margin of error, and 95% confidence level. The survey focuses on the Lula (PT) vs. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) race, following recent polls showing a technical tie or slight edge for the senator, while Lula retains strength in the Northeast but faces wear in urban and Southeastern areas. The poll may reveal whether Bolsonaro’s growth is solidifying, whether Lula has stabilized his support, and what space remains for alternative candidates in the PT-Bolsonaro polarization.

item.title: O que muda com Lei da Dosimetria para Bolsonaro e outros condenados por golpe
item.description: The promulgation of the Dosimetry Law allows those convicted in the January 8, 2023, coup attempt to request sentence reductions and regime progression in the STF. The law unifies penalties for coup d'État and abolition of the Democratic State of Law, easing transition to semi-open or open regimes. Former President Jair Bolsonaro is cited as a potential beneficiary, possibly enabling him to serve sentence before the 2030 elections.

item.title: O zumbi Lula perambula
item.description: The meeting between Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and former U.S. President Donald Trump sparked speculation about Lula's political vitality, with some suggesting the encounter created an impression of an 'active' government, despite being largely symbolic and occurring amid complex geopolitical dynamics, particularly involving China. The image of Lula's supporters excited by the visit contrasts with uncertainties about the meeting's real diplomatic impact.
